published_replay.note: Full current filters on stored metrics, sqrt-mcap weights, market-cap change as the price.

caveats: Past simulated performance. It is not a promise of future results.
The price history is short, and several hours of the live index are still missing.
The basket is the coins that pass the current filters on the latest official snapshot, replayed backward. Coins that failed the filters are not added later. That is survivorship of today's basket.

Holder concentration, launch bundle, authorities, trader count and the $50,000 liquidity floor are applied on the official snapshots. They are not re-checked on earlier hours, because the public candles do not carry those fields.

Each earlier hour still requires a positive close, positive volume and a pool at least 4 hours old. Weights are recomputed every hour from the square root of reconstructed market cap (18% cap, 5% floor).
Market cap is the published market cap scaled by the public price. Supply is assumed constant. Hourly closes ignore trading costs and slippage.
Prices are public pool closes. This is a simulation, not a live result.
SOL line is the CoinGecko SOL/USD hourly price, rebased to 1.
